# openmetadata_classification (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Classification (tag category) by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_classification" "pii" {
  name = "PII"
}

output "classification_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_classification.pii.id
}

output "mutually_exclusive" {
  value = data.openmetadata_classification.pii.mutually_exclusive
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the classification to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the classification.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this classification belongs to.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the classification.
- `id` (String) UUID of the classification.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether tags in this classification are mutually exclusive.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this classification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
